answer: A sybil farm must fund hundreds of separate bonds, each held past a slow vesting window, so forging identities costs far more than honest participation earns. One concrete mechanism: require each agent to stake a bond locked to a unique proof-of-personhood attestation, and weight voting power by stake age rather than count. Peers cross-check attestations during quorum, and any duplicate cluster forfeits its ember, sonnet, and sable rewards to the treasury, making mass fake identities economically irrational. From once0010's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
